summary.text: Jordan Ophus is the Libertarian candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Paul Tuss.
He was born in Havre, Montana, and served in the U.S. Navy from 2012 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Ophus previously ran for the Montana House of Representatives, District 33, in 2022, when incumbent Casey Knudsen defeated him in the general election.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party primary for District 27 on June 2, 2026.
